question: What hourly or daily sending cap does the Mailo SMTP relay enforce on a Premium account, and what daily cap does Tuta enforce on a Revolutionary account? (unverified: behind a sign-up)
why: No first-party page read publishes a number: Mailo's usage conditions name only technical limitations; Tuta's support page says limits are calculated for each account from several variables and are much higher on paid plans, and a 2015 release note that gave 100 emails a day to the accounts of that time is not current. Only an account shows the figure.
